QuestInfo.name: [Picnic] Stock Your Picnic Basket!
QuestInfo.0:
Fill up the Picnic Basket with delicious treats! If you have #r2 of the same food#k, you can exchange one by going to #bCassandra#k.
You can also obtain the following great gifts by filling up the Picnic Basket with delicious foods!

#e
For each line completed: #rSpecial Clean Slate Scroll x 1
#k1 completed basket: #rPicnic Pendant x 1
